dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, when it rains, it seems to disappear slowly.

dialogues.speaker: Nahida
dialogues.text: Yes, and it appears again as soon as the rain stops. It's less like a flower, and more like a Dendro Slime that's trying to keep out of sight.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh, here we go again with Nahida's analogies...
